goal.objective: Add POST /auth/forgot-password and POST /auth/reset-password endpoints with one-time email tokens (1h TTL).
goal.stopping_condition: tests/auth/reset.test.ts passes end-to-end including token expiry case.

mission.expected_behavior: Given a user submits an email to POST /auth/forgot-password, when the email matches an account, then a one-time reset token is generated, persisted with 1h TTL, and emailed to the user.
